# @scramjet/host

This package is part of Scramjet Transform Hub. The package provides the main host subsystem of STH - starts API Servers, creates adapters etc.

## Install

```bash
npm install @scramjet/host
```

## Import

```typescript
import { /* ... */ } from "@scramjet/host";
```

## Documentation

See the [package docs](https://github.com/scramjetorg/transform-hub/tree/HEAD/packages/host) for full documentation.
